"""Camera-guided GR1 controller. One client, no resets or privileged scene state."""
import json, sys, pathlib, pickle, traceback
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
seq=0
obs=None
cmd=None

def record(res):
    global seq,obs,cmd
    obs=res
    p=OUT/f'{seq:03d}'
    res.save(str(p))
    with open(p/'obs.pkl','wb') as f: pickle.dump(res,f)
    cams=list(res.last)
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(640,270*((len(cams)+1)//2)),(30,30,30))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i,c in enumerate(cams):
        im=Image.fromarray(res.last[c]).resize((640//2,240))
        x=(i%2)*320;y=(i//2)*270
        canvas.paste(im,(x,y+25));d.text((x+5,y+5),c,fill='white')
    canvas.save(p/'montage.png')
    pr=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    (OUT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'seq':seq,'proprio':pr,'meta':res.meta},indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'seq':seq,'time_left_s':res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'done':res.done,'proprio':pr}),flush=True)
    seq+=1

record(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'))
layout=obs.meta['proprio']['layout']; now=obs.meta['proprio']['now']
pr=dict(zip(layout,now))
cmd=np.array([pr[k] for k in layout if k.startswith('cmd_')],float)
print('READY '+str(cmd.tolist()),flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        req=json.loads(line)
        if req['op']=='observe':
            record(r.get_obs(cameras=req.get('cameras'),seconds=req.get('seconds',0),include_depth=True,video='none'))
        elif req['op']=='move':
            target=np.array(req.get('target',cmd),float)
            for k,v in req.get('set',{}).items(): target[int(k)]=v
            n=int(req.get('steps',40))
            a=np.linspace(cmd,target,n+1)[1:]
            if req.get('hold',0):a=np.vstack([a,np.tile(target,(req['hold'],1))])
            np.save(OUT/f'actions_{seq:03d}.npy',a)
            res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,cameras=req.get('cameras'),include_depth=True,video='none',note=req.get('note',''))
            cmd=target
            record(res)
            print('CMD '+str(cmd.tolist()),flush=True)
        elif req['op']=='exit': break
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
PY
python -u /app/output/gen.py
